Both changes are shipped as v36.94, and his main PC serves 36.94 (the ship printed `ON HIS PC v36.94` 18 seconds after the ship). I haven't heard either change in a raid, and no 2-player or both-window pass was run.

- **Alarms volume (g-81):**
  - AUDIO now has an ALARMS VOLUME row after footsteps volume: off, 25%, 50%, 75%, full. Full is today's mix.
  - It scales the machine, siege and extraction alarms, the "seen" cue, the raid clock, the lock-on siren, the crit and warn stings, the teammate-down alert, and the two and one minute cues. At off those are silent.
  - Guns, steps and the extraction sting stay on effects.
  - The clock sounds moved from the UI bus to the sting bus, so UI volume no longer moves them. I dropped "and the clock" from the UI volume hint and logged the reason in `notes/ui/changes.md`.
- **Low magazine tick (g-82):**
  - When rounds left after a shot are between 1 and a quarter of the magazine, a light tick plays just after the shot. Only your own window hears it, and there is no setting.
  - The Auto Rifle ticks from 6 left down to 1 left, so the empty gun still gets the dry click and not a tick.
  - Melee and the infinite clip power-up don't tick. It counts as a gun voice for the sound caps.

The new check failed on the old build and passed on the new one. It covers:
- the row and its five steps
- the bus change
- silence at off for each alarm type, the stings, the cues and the siren
- control sounds that stay audible at off (clank, shot, the extraction sting)
- the Auto Rifle tick at 6 left, none at 7 left, and none on the last round

The seed 4242 fingerprint held (ents 85/374, containers 165/593). I took the AUDIO picture at 1080p after the ship (`notes/shots/0p20-152-after/69-settings-sec-audio-1080.jpg`); the new row sits where expected. I didn't run the critic on it, since the screen only gained one standard row.

**Watch next play:**
- At full nothing should sound different.
- At off, the raid clock, siege and extraction alarms, lock-on siren and alert stings go quiet while guns, steps and good-news stings stay.
- UI volume no longer moves the clock ticks.
- The low magazine tick should read under the gunshot without nagging. If it is too present, say so and I'll lower its 0.05 gain.
